## What is the guide about?

One thing to grow or keep. Example: ducks, mushrooms, pigs, cut flowers.

## Do you have real experience with it?

How long, how many, and where. If not, say so. We can look for someone who has.

## Will you write it?

- [ ] Yes, I will open a pull request using `templates/guide-page.md`
- [ ] No, I am asking for someone else to write it

## Sources you plan to use

Own experience, books, official pages. Links if you have them.
